Usage: bin/render_issue_comment_summary ISSUE_OR_ANALYZER

Supported targets:
  25, dogfood, dogfood-ci - Dogfood CI enforcement
  27, deepinheritancetree, deep-inheritance-tree, MetzProject/DeepInheritanceTree - DeepInheritanceTree
  28, repeatedbranching, repeated-branching, MetzProject/RepeatedBranching - RepeatedBranching

Examples:
  bin/render_issue_comment_summary 27
  bin/render_issue_comment_summary MetzProject/RepeatedBranching

Renders local text only; no GitHub comment is posted.
    -h, --help                       Show usage
